units.translation: 473 ff. follows a third reason, which reaches further and makes any decision difficult: I owe consideration to both parties.

⟦1⟧ the scholiast takes intransitively as "grown up", because it was said of animals that have completed the entire change of teeth (⟦2⟧, only a gloss; Nauck ⟦3⟧); this, however, fits absolutely not. But ⟦4⟧ stands: ⟦5⟧ (⟦6⟧ Valcken.), and so the sense here must be: you have come through the pollution, are done with it (like an animal with the change of teeth). A closer determination, however, would be desirable, and there offers itself ⟦7⟧ (Dindorf), cf. what ⟦8⟧ has said. Again, ⟦9⟧ at 474 needs the closer determination; good then Hermann ⟦10⟧ (instead of the second ⟦11⟧ of M; Pauw set it for the first), ⟦12⟧. Also for the city you are ⟦13⟧ (413. 678), because of the purification and because Argos and Athens are not enemies.
but now I am blunt and have completed my evils
but I respect you as blameless for the city
⟦1⟧ (M) cannot simply = ⟦2⟧, as the scholiast explains; for ⟦3⟧ Hermann compares ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧ Hom.).
they respect the suppliants of Zeus
to respect the suppliants of the gods (with reverent suppliants)
⟦1⟧ cf. 105, the nature and kind given by fate (⟦2⟧ Schol.).
these are hard to please by nature

⟦1⟧ seems = ⟦2⟧, Homer Il. 16.748 ⟦3⟧, in Hesiod ⟦4⟧ 722 also of a person, ⟦5⟧, difficult against, so that the scholiast explains correctly. Paley, to be sure, compares ⟦6⟧ . . ⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧ and below ⟦9⟧ 481; against this Lobeck Pathol. proleg. p. 105 (Herm.) already contradicts the identification of -⟦10⟧ and -⟦11⟧. So "you may remain, but these I also cannot easily send away".
a feast hard to send away
a chorus hard to send out
⟦1⟧ remains pretty much what it was. In 477 f. ⟦2⟧ . . ⟦3⟧ is again anacoluthon as at 95 ff. 100 f.; for ⟦4⟧ Paley well compares ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ (below 719 ⟦7⟧).
that this matter may turn out well for you
